say:0:1013530001:0.text: He might be strange, but Chippy thinks he's trustworthy! And strong!
say:0:1013530001:0.source_cn: 那个蛮血大块头还是很有眼光的嘛，虽然方式很奇怪，但很尊...
say:0:1013530001:0.male: He might be strange, but Chippy thinks he's trustworthy! And strong!
say:0:1013530001:0.female: He might be strange, but Chippy thinks he's trustworthy! And strong!

say:1:1013530002:0.text: He even respected our magister's amazing power!
say:1:1013530002:0.source_cn: 主人本来就很厉害，用不着他来承认！
say:1:1013530002:0.male: He even respected our magister's amazing power!
say:1:1013530002:0.female: He even respected our magister's amazing power!

say:2:1013530003:0.text: Exactly, Hammie! Anyone who respects our Magister Merlin is trustworthy.
say:2:1013530003:0.source_cn: 漫漫，你说得对，主人可是全天下最厉害的魔法师！
say:2:1013530003:0.male: Exactly, Hammie! Anyone who respects our Magister Merlin is trustworthy.
say:2:1013530003:0.female: Exactly, Hammie! Anyone who respects our Magister Merlin is trustworthy.

say:3:1013530004:0.text: Hmm. Something feels off up ahead, let's be cautious.
say:3:1013530004:0.source_cn: ……嗯，前方的气息有异，小心前进。
say:3:1013530004:0.male: Hmm. Something feels off up ahead, let's be cautious.
say:3:1013530004:0.female: Hmm. Something feels off up ahead, let's be cautious.

say:4:1013530005:0.text: Got it! I'll keep my guard up!
say:4:1013530005:0.source_cn: 遵命，满满开启警戒模式！
say:4:1013530005:0.male: Got it! I'll keep my guard up!
say:4:1013530005:0.female: Got it! I'll keep my guard up!
